name: grounded
description: Optional CEO scope review, engineering review, ADR authoring, and shared-rule setup.

interface.longDescription: Three optional development skills for focused use when needed: a CEO-style scope review, an engineering plan review, and guided ADR authoring. Works with OpenSpec artifacts or a clear request and chat plan. These skills review or document decisions; they do not automatically implement changes or start other workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $grounded:setup to connect Grounded shared rules to this host.
Use $grounded:plan-review-ceo to review scope and challenge the implementation plan.
Use $grounded:plan-review-eng to review the engineering plan and test coverage.
Use $grounded:adr to document this durable architecture decision.

publication.release_notes: Grounded 0.2.0: shared-rule onboarding, unified plugin layout, and version-checked release packages.
